_description.site_name: LEF SITE name as defined in the macro LEF. FC renames this to 'unit' during CLIB build (LEFR-064); use 'unit' in floorplan Tcl.
_description.family_cell_name_regexp: Regex to extract cell family base name from full cell name (same convention as Cadence pdk_config.json).
_description.power_net: Primary power rail name in LEF/liberty.
_description.ground_net: Primary ground rail name in LEF/liberty.
_description.bufs_for_clock: Glob pattern for CTS buffer cells.
_description.invs_for_clock: Glob pattern for CTS inverter cells.
_description.tech_file: Synopsys .tf technology file, relative to PDK root (PDK_DIR/PDK_NAME/).
_description.tech_lef: Technology LEF file, relative to PDK root.
_description.macro_lef: List of macro/cell LEF files, relative to PDK root.
_description.worst_db: List of worst-corner Synopsys .db liberty files for FC, relative to PDK root.
_description.best_db: List of best-corner .db files, or null to reuse worst_db.
_description.tlup_file: TLUPlus parasitic model file (.tlup), relative to PDK root. Equivalent to qrc_max in Cadence pdk_config.json.
_description.layer_map_file: TLUPlus layer map file, relative to the FC flow directory (not PDK root).
_description.floorplan_file: Flow-side Tcl floorplan script, relative to the FC flow directory. Empty string if none.
_description.pdn_file: Flow-side Tcl PDN (power delivery network) script, relative to the FC flow directory. Sourced after floorplan to build physical power network. Empty string if none.
_description.routing.layer_direction_offset_list: FC ROUTING_LAYER_DIRECTION_OFFSET_LIST: space-separated {layer direction offset} triples for all layers.

routing.layer_direction_offset_list: {M0 horizontal 0.012} {M1 vertical 0.030} {M2 horizontal 0.012} {M3 vertical 0.0} {M4 horizontal 0.0} {M5 vertical 0.0} {M6 horizontal 0.0} {M7 vertical 0.0} {M8 horizontal 0.0} {M9 vertical 0.0} {M10 horizontal 0.0} {M11 vertical 0.0} {M12 horizontal 0.0} {M13 vertical 0.0}
